title: Juicy Slovakian Beef Stew
description: A hearty one-pot Slovakian dish featuring mixed beef cuts in a rich buttery sauce, cooked to perfection in a lazy Susan spinner, this recipe is ayurvedic tamasic friendly and has a nice char grill yang flavor
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of butter in the lazy Susan spinner over medium heat
Add the beef cubes and cook until browned on all sides
Remove the browned beef from the spinner and set aside
Add the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter to the spinner and saute the onion until softened
Add the carrots and potatoes to the spinner and cook for 5 minutes
Add the flour to the spinner and stir to combine
Gradually add the beef broth to the spinner, whisking continuously
Return the browned beef to the spinner and season with salt and pepper
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1.5 hours
